# FastMediaSorter v2 - GitHub Copilot Instructions

## 1. Browser / Web Access
- Browse via MCP playwright (`navigate` → `snapshot` / `take_screenshot`). Never `fetch_webpage`.

## 2. Style & Communication
- Chat: RU. Code/Docs/Logs/Commits: EN. Dry, concise.
- Ellipsis / Dash / Ё (documentation prose & user-visible UI text ONLY): use `..` (never `...`), plain hyphen `-` (never `-`, `–`, `―`), and RU Ё/ё where grammatically correct. Never enforce these typography rules in code, technical specs, commands, logs, or chat.
- Caveman Mode: trigger `/caveman` / `be brief`. RU chat, EN code, drop filler.
- Spec Writing: lists over tables (tables only 3+ columns); no pseudographics; no self-evident links; one idea per bullet; no section summaries; Draft specs exempt.
- No self-cost estimates in any planning output (CLAUDE.md section 1): no time, no effort, no predicted line count, in specs, phase files or chat. Sizes measured off a real file (2000-LOC ceiling, 500-LOC backup threshold) are not estimates and stay.

## 3. Skill Rules (Mandatory Slash Commands)
- Each `/name` is the file `.claude/commands/<name>.md` - that file is the whole procedure, so read it in full before the first step. Companions for the six largest pipelines: `.claude/reference/<name>.md`; verbatim skeletons: `.claude/templates/`. `.github/prompts/` was retired (S1787) - the Copilot prompt mirrors had drifted beyond parity and were deleted.
- `/quick`: minor fix (design, typo, 1 string), skip spec/build; update `dev/CHANGELOG.md`.
- `/skill-fix`: fast bug/UI fix, and the doc/config/script tweak that needs no gradle; skip doc/git/build/dev-log/spec; local validation only.
- `/spec*`: spec lifecycle (`/spec`, `/spec-all`, `/spec-tech`, `/spec-update`, `/spec-dev`, `/spec-check`, `/spec-fix`, `/spec-arc`, `/spec-test-device`, `/spec-sweep`, `/spec-next`, `/spec-do`, `/spec-code`, `/spec-draft`, `/spec-quiz`, `/spec-prerelease`).
- `/ui-clarify`: resolve layout/UX ambiguity before design/impl.
- `/catalog`: class/feature queries; run `scripts/catalog_sync.ps1`.
- `/doc-update`: docs sync.
- `/log-reader`: logcat/log analysis.
- `/build`, `/git`, `/caveman`, `/caveman-commit`, `/caveman-review`.

## 4. Routing & Structure
- Entrypoints: `dev/PROJECT_OPERATIONS_INDEX.md` (workspace routing), `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` (architecture), `docs/DEV_OPS.md` (PowerShell/build), `docs/TECH_STACK.md` + `dev/TECH_REQUIREMENTS.md` (dependencies).
- Document-registry loop: mandatory at task start, material scope change, phase boundary, and before final response - see `.claude/skills/document-registry/SKILL.md`.
- Topology: `app_v2/` (main), `wear/` (Wear OS), `dev/`, `docs/`, `scripts/`, `temp/`. Read-only zones, no exceptions (CLAUDE.md Rule 4): `V1/`, `v2_6/`, `spec_v2/`, `dev/archive/`.
- Packages: `ui/` (no business logic), `domain/`, `data/`, `di/`, `core/`, `util/`, `utils/`, `worker/`, `widget/`.

## 5. Strict Constraints
1. No root writes (CLAUDE.md Rule 1); use `temp/`, organized by ticket: ticket-bound work -> `temp/Sxxxx/`, no active ticket -> `temp/scratch/`. Fixed infra stays at `temp/` root (`BUILD.LOCK`, `CODE.LOCK`, `spec-all-queue.lock`, `done/`, `spec-next-skip-cache.json`, `current.log` + `fastmediasorter_*.log`, stream-catalog files).
2. File size limit 2000 LOC (CLAUDE.md Rule 2). Extract logic to `helpers/*Manager.kt`.
3. No Activity logic (CLAUDE.md Rule 3). Delegate to Manager/Helper classes.
4. Timber only (no `Log.d()`). No `Sxxxx` ticket in permanent logs.
5. Safety backup (CLAUDE.md Rule 5): timestamped copy under `temp/Sxxxx/` (or `temp/scratch/` when no ticket) before editing file >500 LOC.
6. Changelog: run `.\scripts\add_to_dev_log.ps1` after every change (except `/skill-fix`).
7. Feature docs: record new capabilities in `docs/ALL_FEATURES.jsonl` via `scripts/all_features/add.ps1`. `docs/FEATURES*.md` is generated by `/skill-release` only - never edited per-spec.
8. Comment discipline (CLAUDE.md Rule 9): EN-only, WHY not WHAT, no trivial comments, remove stale ones.
9. Script ownership (CLAUDE.md Rule 13): fix buggy/insufficient project scripts, don't work around them.
10. UI trigger row: use `SettingsToggleRow` for switch rows; follow XML standards for checkbox.
11. UI Ambiguity Gate (CLAUDE.md Rule 10): resolve placement/visibility/fallback before impl.
12. System bar safety (CLAUDE.md Rule 17): keep UI inside `systemBars` + `displayCutout` safe bounds (fitsSystemWindows not enough).
13. Layout orientation (CLAUDE.md Rule 11): editing portrait XML must check/edit landscape counterpart.
14. PowerShell Efficiency: always `-NoProfile`; batch `& { c1; if... }`; literal `$LASTEXITCODE`; use project wrappers.
15. Lazy optimization (CLAUDE.md Rule 18): Hilt `dagger.Lazy<T>`; `<ViewStub>` for optional layouts; release player/media resources immediately when paused.
16. Dead-weight hygiene (CLAUDE.md Rule 20): delete orphaned classes, resources, string keys, keep rules in same change.
17. Detekt-clean-first and neuroslop avoidance (CLAUDE.md Rule 19): author touched `.kt` to pass detekt on the first build - log/probe lines `<=120` chars, no bare numeric literals (`TimeUnit`/companion `const`/reuse a const), never `@Suppress` a method with a baselined finding. No trivial comments, no broad/empty catch, no hex colours in layout XML, no lifecycle-unsafe Flow collection, no `GlobalScope`, no non-Timber logging, no shipped `TODO()`, no typographic long dashes in `.kt`. Gate: `scripts/quality/assert-neuroslop.ps1`. On the always-dirty tree close via `scripts/post-change.ps1 -ScopeToFile` (diff-scoped detekt + advisory project-wide ratchets); omit for release/CI.
18. Bash `find` safety (CLAUDE.md Rule 24): never run `find` with a disk-wide root path (`/`, `~`, drive root, `/c/`, `//host`) or without `-maxdepth`; prefer Glob/Grep or `dev/CATALOG/scripts/query.ps1`. On Windows/MSYS an orphaned `find.exe` from a dropped session scans the whole disk and floods handles.
19. Hooks intercept tool calls (CLAUDE.md Rule 29): a hook may **refuse** a call, **rewrite** its input, **observe** its result or **warn**. `docs/AGENT_HOOKS.md` is the complete inventory - every registered hook, its event, verdict shape, escape hatch, and whether it is global (per-machine, absent on a fresh checkout) or project (travels with the repository). A refusal names its hook and rule, so read the inventory when a call is refused or a result looks altered. Two alter calls without a rule of their own: `guard-catalog-before-kt-search` refuses an unnarrowed `.kt` search until the class catalogue was queried this session, and `guard-uncapped-read` rewrites a `Read` carrying no explicit window. Gate: `scripts/quality/assert-hook-inventory.ps1`.
20. Settings docs sync (CLAUDE.md Rule 22): any change to a setting, including one hosted in a dialog/bottom-sheet/wizard page, must regenerate `docs/settings/settings-manifest.json` + `docs/SETTINGS_REFERENCE*.md` and update `docs/settings/settings-annotations.json`. A non-screen surface registers in `SettingsDocScopeCatalog`, never in `SettingsSearchLayoutCatalog` (S1035/S1313). Gate: `scripts/quality/assert-settings-doc-sync.ps1`.
21. Naming (CLAUDE.md Rule 6): `VerbNounUseCase`, `NounRepository`, `NounViewModel`, `NounVerbManager`.
22. Lint (CLAUDE.md Rule 7): fix the warnings in the files you touched, not only the ones you introduced.
23. Read before editing (CLAUDE.md Rule 8): the comments and KDoc already in the area are requirements - read them first, never override one silently.
24. Spec catalog is script-owned (CLAUDE.md Rule 12): never hand-edit `PLAN/spec-catalog.jsonl`, never rename an `Sxxxx_` prefix; mutate through `scripts/spec_catalog/*.ps1`.
25. Flavor isolation (CLAUDE.md Rule 14): no `BuildConfig.IS_*` flavor guards in `src/main/` - use an interface plus flavor source sets.
26. Evidence per step (CLAUDE.md Rule 15): a non-trivial step records the validation command run and its exit code or PASS/FAIL. "Should pass" is not evidence.
27. Input coverage (CLAUDE.md Rule 16): every interactive surface supports keyboard, D-pad/TV and mouse - set `focusable`, `clickable`, `nextFocus*`.
28. Deprecated PackageManager flags (CLAUDE.md Rule 21): no raw-int `getPackageInfo`/`getApplicationInfo`/`queryIntentActivities`/`resolveActivity` in `src/main` - use the `*Compat` helpers in `util/PackageManagerCompat.kt`. Gate: the `deprecated-pm-flags` dimension of `scripts/quality/assert-source-gates.ps1`, run on every closure via the `neuroslop-gate` umbrella in `post-change.ps1`. `assert-deprecated-pm-flags.ps1` is a named forwarder for running that one rule by hand.
29. Concurrent-agent locks, split by domain (CLAUDE.md Rule 23, S2109): a coordination resource is a pair, type plus domain - `Build.Phone`, `Build.Wear`, `Code.Phone`, `Code.Wear`, `Code.Scripts`, listed once in `scripts/utils/agent-lock-domains.ps1`. A script invoking `gradlew` takes its build domains (`Enter-BuildLockOrExit -Domain <..>`, defaulting to both); a multi-file source edit takes its code domains via `scripts/utils/enter-code-lock.ps1 -Files "<changed paths>" -Reason "..."`, which derives them from the paths and falls back to the full set for anything it cannot place. `PLAN/` is the one exemption (S2338): a spec file belongs to exactly one ticket held by `ticket-lease.ps1`, and the journals plus both release files are written only through catalog mutators holding the catalog's own mutex, so a PLAN-only set resolves to **no domain at all** and the script exits **0** with nothing acquired and nothing to release. `docs/` and `dev/` are not exempt - they are hand-edited with nothing finer over them. Since S2342 the same reasoning puts content with no code in it on `Code.Scripts` rather than the full set: the trees `play/`, `fastlane/`, `store_assets/`, `delivery/`, `maestro/` and the root site pages, documents and icons cannot belong to a module - none of them compiles, links or packs into an APK - so failing closed on them serialised phone and watch work against a store-listing edit for nothing (measured 2026-09-02: 8 of the 11 recent full-set acquisitions were content only). The remainder still fails closed, `corex/` and the domain-less modules `benchmark/` and `watchface/` included. Sessions collide only where their domains overlap, so a watch edit and a phone edit proceed at once. Multi-domain work is taken all at once in canonical order, all or nothing. A busy domain queues rather than refuses - `enter-code-lock.ps1` exits **4** for "queued, not your turn yet". Wait with `scripts/utils/wait-for-lock-turn.ps1 -Name <domain> -Handoff <path from the exit-4 message>` in the background and meanwhile do work needing no lock - the handoff keeps one intent on one ticket across the process boundary (S2403): without a session id the waiter is a stranger to the first ticket, takes a second one, and waits out the reservation window behind its own dead ticket. The window is the edit and nothing else (S2419): take the code lock immediately before the step's first edit and release it with your own `scripts/utils/exit-code-lock.ps1` the moment that step's last file is written - the verification predicates, the phase's compile (already serialised by `Build.*`), the unit suite, the gate batch, the dev log and the catalog all run outside it. Abandon a queued intent and you must withdraw your own place - `scripts/utils/withdraw-lock-ticket.ps1 -Name <domain>` (`.\a.ps1 uqb` / `uqc`): the eviction sweep judges the owning session, so a live session's dropped ticket head-blocks everyone behind it until it is withdrawn (S2098). One case self-heals (S2194): a head whose turn was granted and not taken within that domain's reservation window is dropped by the sweep itself. A ticket that was never granted a turn is never dropped by age, so withdrawal stays mandatory for an intent you abandon before your turn arrives.
30. No `.ps1` as a Bash command head (CLAUDE.md Rule 25): Bash cannot execute a PowerShell script and the failure still reports **exit 0**, so a failed build looks like it passed. Always `pwsh -NoProfile -File ./a.ps1 <cmd>`.
31. No fire-and-forget verdict (CLAUDE.md Rule 26): never background a gate, a closure facade or a catalog mutator (`post-change.ps1`, `assert-*.ps1`, the `spec_catalog`/`document_registry`/`all_features` CLIs, `add_to_dev_log.ps1`, `catalog_sync.ps1`, `a.ps1 fk/fkn/fc/fr/fg/dq/ch/ss/bf`). Their exit code is the entire product, and a verdict nobody reads in the same turn is not a verdict. A genuinely long job on the same line still backgrounds normally.
32. No slash-command name as an argument value in a Bash-tool `pwsh` call (CLAUDE.md Rule 27): `-Reason "/spec-dev .."` arrives as `C:/Program Files/Git/spec-dev ..` because MSYS reads the leading slash as a POSIX path, and the corruption is silent - exit 0, mangled text in the lock/queue/lease diagnostics. Use `-Reason "//spec-dev .."`, prefix `MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL='*'`, or call from the PowerShell tool.
33. No command in the Bash tool that cannot exist there (CLAUDE.md Rule 28): a PowerShell cmdlet in command-head position, an interpreter that is not installed (`node`, `npm`, `npx`), and the batching idiom `& { .. }` at the start of a command are each an `exit 127` that returns nothing. Run the pipeline in the PowerShell tool or via `pwsh -NoProfile -Command "<pipeline>"`. `python3` is not refused - it shims to the `python` on PATH.
34. Thirteen locales for a new UI string (CLAUDE.md Rule 30): a key added to `values/strings*.xml` reaches every locale in `app_v2/src/main/res/xml/locales_config.xml` before the release, not only `en`/`ru`/`uk`. The refusal sits at pre-release (`scripts/quality/assert-new-lexemes-translated.ps1`, step 0.8 of `/spec-prerelease`); the authoring call and the ticket close only name what is missing.
35. Subagent model routing (CLAUDE.md Rule 31): mechanical, search, and doc subagent tasks must explicitly specify lightweight model tiers (`model: sonnet` or `flash`); unpinned `general-purpose` defaults to Opus.
36. Compose boundary (CLAUDE.md Rule 32): `app_v2` is View + XML + ViewBinding, `wear` is Compose. A new `setContent { .. }` under `app_v2/src/main` is refused by the `compose-island` ratchet in `scripts/quality/assert-source-gates.ps1`; the six existing islands leave opportunistically and each removal only lowers the baseline.

37. Gate placement (CLAUDE.md Rule 33): a gate whose subject is the whole tree or a shipped artifact runs once over the release scope (`scripts/quality/assert-release-scope-gates.ps1`, step 0.4 of `/spec-prerelease`), not per changed file, because per file it cannot attribute its finding. It stays per-ticket when later work builds on the defect, when the evidence exists only at the moment of the change, or when agents read the artifact between releases. Relocate by script with an exit code, never by a line of prose.
38. Agent chat (CLAUDE.md Rule 34, S2372): a descriptive layer beside the locks under `temp/AGENT-CHAT/` - `progress/` (what a session is doing, 180 min of life) and `findings/` (a measurement or an environment state, dead when anything in its declared scope changes, its TTL passes or its device leaves `adb devices`). The coordination scripts, `update.ps1`, `post-change.ps1`, the fast checks and the device probe write it themselves; the model posts three lines through `scripts/utils/agent-chat.ps1 -Verb Post` - a phase start, a stage boundary, giving work up (`-Kind abandon`). Read at a refusal (`enter-code-lock.ps1` exit 4, `ticket-lease.ps1` exit 3 print the holder's last lines), in `spec-next-preflight.ps1` (`leased_ids[].last_chat`), in the monitor, or explicitly with `-Verb Read|Find|Status`. Trust rule: the chat decides nothing - no acquisition branches on it and no spec or gate verdict rests on another agent's finding; a finding spares you repeating cheap idempotent work, never the report. Identity: `scripts/utils/agent-identity.ps1` (`FMS_AGENT_ID`, then `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID`, then the ancestor host process `host-<name>-<pid>-<startTicks>` - where the walk runs into a machine-wide process it adopts the ancestor directly below it rather than giving up, and records the outcome as `hostWalk` (S2417) - then `pid-<PID>` for a walk that found no ancestor at all), never empty, plus a per-session nickname `<adjective>-<animal>-<MMdd>-<HHmm>` taken on the first identity resolution and kept under `temp/AGENT-CHAT/names/` (`FMS_AGENT_NAME` overrides, `-Verb Whoami` prints it) - the owner reads names, scripts compare ids. **You have no hooks, so set `FMS_AGENT_ID` first**, to one value you keep for your whole session, before `FMS_AGENT_RUNTIME` / `FMS_AGENT_MODEL`; measured 2026-09-02, a Copilot session that set only the last two collected four different nicknames in two minutes, and another runtime wrote itself as 46 agents in an hour - each of them looked dead within a minute, so siblings took their tickets and every release was forced. Without the variable S2408 gives you a floor rather than that: the chain climbs your ancestors past shells and interpreters to the first process that outlives a command, so your own commands agree with each other - but two of your chats in one editor window then share one identity, which is why setting it is still yours to do. Post `-Kind session` at start and end yourself.

39. Device fleet (CLAUDE.md Rule 35): `docs/DEVICE_FLEET.md` is the roster of every physical device, emulator and the workstation, and the only home of a per-device permission - read it and match the serial before the first `adb` call of a task, because authorization is per device, never per "a device is attached". Free hand on the **Galaxy S21+** test phone (`SM-G996U1`), on **emulators** at any form factor, and on the **Galaxy Watch 7** (`SM-L310`, the development watch, paired with the S25 FE). The owner's **Galaxy S25 FE** (`SM-S731B`) carries his live `noLegal` debug with real private data plus the store STANDARD build he tracks updates on: install a fresh `noLegal` debug over the top, `pm grant`, and read-only probing are allowed, while `pm clear`, `uninstall`, a system role, a device settings change and the store build are not. The **Galaxy S20 FE** (`SM-G781B`) is a rare guest phone, read-only. This workstation is the owner's personal machine as well as the build machine - never shut it down or reboot it, and never kill a process your session did not start. Default target when a ticket needs "some device": emulator -> S21+ -> S25 FE, a deviation stated. Never restate a device permission in a command, skill or agent file - point at the roster.

## 6. Workflow Stages (5-Step Engineering Workflow)
- Step 0 TASK DEFINITION: ask clarifying questions; output RU desc to `dev/`; UI gate checks.
- Step 1 RESEARCH: analyze AS-IS; collect exact lines/files/paths to `temp/Sxxxx/` (or `temp/scratch/`).
- Step 2 DESIGN: C4 design; output RU design to `dev/`; wait for human review.
- Step 3 PLANNING: EN execution plan as markdown checklist.
- Step 4 IMPLEMENTATION: execute step-by-step; build/commit after each step; update features inventory.

## 7. Code Audit Protocol
- Full protocol: `docs/CODE_AUDIT_PROTOCOL.md`. Apply it on any audit trigger: new screen/manager/worker/repository/long-lived helper; lifecycle/coroutine/Flow/listener/observer change; shared-state/dispatcher change; Room entity/DAO/query/migration/transaction change; player/image/cache/network change; startup change; DI scope/singleton change; build/manifest/R8/keep-rule change affecting profiling/startup/minification; reported crash/ANR/OOM/jank/leak.
- Tag every finding by severity P0-P3 (P0 crash/leak/data-loss blocks release; P1 race / main-thread I/O / unbounded cache / unreleased resource; P2 hot-path churn / over-eager startup; P3 readability/style). P0/P1 need evidence, not opinion.
- Listener symmetry: every `register*`/`addListener`/`addObserver` has a matching removal on the symmetric lifecycle edge.
- No main-thread Room (`allowMainThreadQueries()` banned); DAO `suspend`/`Flow`; atomic multi-step writes in `@Transaction`/`withTransaction`.
- One owner per `ExoPlayer` with a full release contract (`release()` + `setVideoSurface(null)` + remove listeners + abandon focus); mirror across player hosts. Glide decode-at-size + `clear(target)` on detach.
- Reflection/serialization/DI/manifest/dependency changes are proven on the minified release/target variant, not only debug (extends dead-weight Rule 16).

## 8. Scripts Reference
- Logs: `scripts/utils/search-log.ps1` (`-Summary`, `-Spam`, `-Errors`, `-Warnings`, `-Pattern`, `-Tag`).
- Builds: `scripts/builders/build-debug.PS1` (`-SkipZip`, `-AutoVersion`), `build-debug-clean.PS1`, `build-lite-debug.ps1`, `build-photos-debug.ps1`, `build-legacy-debug.ps1`, `clean-gradle-caches.ps1`, `build-standard-release.ps1`, `build-wear-release.PS1`.
- Fast checks: `scripts/builders/check-standard-fast.ps1 -Mode Code|Resources|CodeAndResources|Unit|Assemble [-Flavor Standard|NoLegal|Lite|Photos|Legacy]`. Prefer `Code` / `CodeAndResources` over full debug APK builds when only a few symbols changed.
- Gate batch: `scripts/quality/assert-fast-gates.ps1` runs the fast static gates (no-ticket-logs, flavor-flags, neuroslop, deprecated-pm, listener-symmetry) in one process (`-IncludeDetekt` opt-in).
- Closure facade: `scripts/post-change.ps1 -ChangeType <type>` chains dev-log + catalog-sync + gates; use `Tooling` for build/config-plus-script sets, and add `-ScopeToFile` for per-change closure on the always-dirty tree (source gates require matching files; detekt stays diff-scoped).
- Device: `scripts/utils/extract-device-logs.ps1`, `Install_release_on_adb_connected_device.ps1`, `build-standard-device.ps1`.
- Tests: `scripts/utils/run-maestro-smoke.ps1`, `run-stress.ps1`, `setup_test_media.ps1`.
- Utilities: `scripts/utils/commit-push.ps1`, `generate-changelog.ps1`, `check-typo-lint.ps1`, `set-android-string.ps1`, `add_to_dev_log.ps1`, `catalog_sync.ps1`.
